history.content: Find me a good ergonomic chair under $300 and tell me if I should buy it now.

Two solid picks under $300, both in stock right now: 1. Branch Ergonomic Chair, $269. Named the best budget pick for 2026, adjustable lumbar and arms, no backorder. 2. Staples Hyken, $230. The classic value pick, mesh back, headrest, and it leaves $70 in your pocket. My take: if you sit long hours, the Branch at $269 is the one worth it. If you want the deal, the Hyken at $230 is genuinely good for the money. On "buy it now": these are evergreen models, not flash sales, so there's no price cliff you're missing by waiting a week. I'd only pull the trigger now if your current chair is actively hurting your back, that cost adds up faster than any discount. Want me to order one? Say which and I'll set it up for your approval.
